如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    沐如岚走到蓝一阳病房门口，敲了敲门，里面传出一道带着鼻音的怒吼，“他妈给老子滚！”
沐如森和沐如霖把蓝一阳的鼻梁骨给打断了。
沐如岚怔了下，拎着粥推开门，这是VIP病房，只有他一个人住，宽敞又明亮，而此时病床上，蓝一阳头上绑着纱布，鼻子上也贴着纱布，左脚还打着厚厚的石膏，右手臂也夹着夹板，看起来都快成木乃伊了。
此时这木乃伊根本没发现门口站了个人，因为他正费劲儿的用不麻利的左手拿放在右边床头桌上的苹果，不知道哪个缺德的王八蛋竟然忽视了他受伤严重的右手，把苹果放在了右边，嗯……还差一点点，还差一点点，苹果，他的红苹果……
蓝一阳很专注，他专注的想要拿那红彤彤的苹果，骨节分明显得意外好看的手爬啊爬，可偏偏怎么也够不到，太他妈的气人了，少年气得脸颊都红了，该死的他要吃苹果！
一只很漂亮的白皙的手伸了过来，拿起了他觊觎已久的红苹果。
蓝一阳错愕的抬头，沐如岚笑容浅淡温暖的看着他，他怔了下，顿时眉头一皱，眼底一片阴霾，他当然知道这人是谁，那两个混蛋小子的姐姐！而且还是宠着那两个混蛋小子的姐姐！
“你没事吧？”沐如岚拿着苹果，把粥放在桌面，粥和菜被封得严实，不把盖子蓝一阳嘴角扯了扯，看着沐如岚眼底有些阴霾狠辣，“没事？你看我这样像没事吗？”
沐如岚还没说话，蓝一阳又阴险嘲讽的道：“我告诉你，这件事我是绝对不会善罢甘休的，你也不用担心，我自己的事我没有告诉家长的习惯，但是今天那两个王八蛋伤了我一只脚，哪天被我逮到机会我就砍他两只，伤我鼻子一下，我戳他两个眼珠！”蓝一阳也不是什么好鸟，不过他是个天才，天天插科打诨到了关键时刻稍微努力用功一下，就能把努力用功的人气死，可也就是这样，这天才越来越坏越来越任性了，他本来跟爷爷在澳大利亚住的，但是爷爷管不住他，才把人遣回国让他爸妈管教的。
只是他们绝对想不到，这才回国不到一星期，这混小子又闹事了，而且还是跟K市鼎鼎大名的沐家沐公子给闹上了。
沐如岚只是静静的看着他，嘴角的笑容浅了一些，却依旧柔和，等蓝一阳说完了，她才拿起水果刀慢慢的给苹果削皮。
蓝一阳说的心里有点兴奋，仿佛已经把沐如森和沐如霖大卸八块了似的，一抬眼见沐如岚在削果皮，一句话急忙出声，“我要连着皮吃的！”
沐如岚动作一顿，抬眼看蓝一阳，看到蓝一阳表情有点尴尬，她嘴角笑容却温柔了起来，“知道了。”
蓝一阳看着沐如岚走进浴室给他洗了苹果，然后把削了一小块皮的苹果放在他左手边喝水的玻璃杯口上，沐如岚又走回右边，想要把蓝一阳扶起来坐好，蓝一阳警惕的别过身子，狭长的桃花眼一眯，“你想干什么？”
“躺着怎么吃饭？”沐如岚眼神指了下桌上的袋子。
蓝一阳想到了什么，嘴角不屑一扯，“你以为这样我就会放过那两个小王八蛋么？我告诉你，就算你他妈脱光了躺在我面前求我都不可能！”谁他妈稀罕一碗粥啊！他蓝一阳从来打架就没人敢动他脸一下，结果那两混蛋把他鼻梁都打断了，这仇按照他以往的性子，得记到他偿还对方十倍后才行！
沐如岚动作一顿，她缓缓的站直了身子，嘴角一向温暖的笑容消失了，澄澈的眼眸看着他，带着几分谴责和冷漠，一下子形成的剧烈反差，叫人浑身不自在。
蓝一阳瞪着眼睛看她。
沐如岚道：“你可能误会了。今天我到这里来，不是为了让你原谅我两个弟弟，只是因为他们做错了，所谓长姐如母，我没有教好他们，害你受伤，我不对，所以我尽这个责任和义务，医药费和道歉我都会做到位，但是请你也别忘了，你是为什么会被我弟弟打，你在大街上忽然听到有莫名其妙的男人说想上你妈，你不会生气愤怒吗？”
蓝一阳眼眸瞪大，微微张着嘴惊讶的看着她。他没想到这个让他觉得温暖到有点做作的女人竟然会做出这样的比喻，可是很意外的，这个人就这么显得真实起来了……

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Mu Rulan walked to the door of Lan Yiyang's ward and knocked on the door. A nasal roar came from inside, "Get the fuck out of here!"
Mu Rushen and Mu Rulin broke Lan Yiyang's nose.
Mu Rulan was startled for a moment and opened the door while carrying the porridge. This was a VIP ward. He was the only one who lived in it. It was spacious and bright. On the hospital bed, Lan Yiyang had gauze tied on his head and gauze on his nose. His left foot was still in a thick plaster, and his right arm was also splinted. He looked like he was almost mummified.
At this time, the mummy didn't notice anyone standing at the door, because he was struggling to use his left hand to pick up the apple on the bedside table on the right. Some unscrupulous bastard actually ignored his seriously injured right hand and put the apple on the right. Well... it's still a little bit short, a little bit short, apple, his red apple...
Lan Yiyang was very focused. He wanted to get the red apple, and his hands with obvious joints were crawling and crawling, but he couldn't reach it. It was so damn irritating. The boy's cheeks turned red with anger. Damn it, he wanted to eat the apple!
A beautiful white hand stretched out and picked up the red apple he had coveted for a long time.
Lan Yiyang raised his head in astonishment, and Mu Rulan looked at him with a warm smile. He was startled for a moment, his brows furrowed, and his eyes were filled with haze. Of course he knew who this person was, the sister of those two bastard boys! And she is the sister who dotes on those two bastard boys!
"Are you okay?" Mu Rulan took the apple and put the porridge on the table. The porridge and vegetables were tightly sealed. Lan Yiyang pulled the corner of his mouth and looked at Mu Rulan's eyes, which were hazy and fierce. "Is everything okay? Do you think I'm fine?"
Before Mu Rulan could speak, Lan Yiyang said in a sinister and sarcastic manner: "Let me tell you, I will never give up on this matter, and you don't have to worry. I don't have the habit of telling my parents about my own affairs, but today those two bastards hurt one of my feet. If I get a chance one day, I will chop them both, hurt my nose once, and poke both of his eyes!" "Lan Yiyang is not a good guy, but he is a genius. He makes jokes every day and at critical moments, if he works hard, he can make people who work hard to death. But that's it, the genius is getting worse and more willful. He originally lived with his grandfather in Australia, but his grandfather couldn't control him, so he sent him back to China to be disciplined by his parents.
But they never expected that less than a week after returning to China, this bastard would cause trouble again, and he would also get into trouble with Mr. Mu of the Mu family, who was famous in K City.
Mu Rulan just looked at him quietly, the smile on her lips became lighter but still gentle. After Lan Yiyang finished speaking, she picked up the fruit knife and slowly peeled the apple.
Lan Yiyang felt a little excited when he said this, as if he had cut Mu Rusen and Mu Rulin into eight pieces. When he looked up, he saw Mu Rulan peeling the fruit, and hurriedly said, "I want to eat it with the skin on!"
Mu Rulan paused and looked up at Lan Yiyang. Seeing that Lan Yiyang's expression was a little embarrassed, the smile on her lips turned gentle, "I know."
Lan Yiyang watched Mu Rulan walk into the bathroom and wash the apple for him, then put a small piece of peeled apple on the rim of the drinking glass on his left hand. Mu Rulan walked back to the right and wanted to help Lan Yiyang sit up. Lan Yiyang turned away warily and narrowed his narrow peach blossom eyes, "What do you want to do?"
"How can you eat while lying down?" Mu Rulan pointed at the bag on the table.
Lan Yiyang thought of something and curled up his lips with disdain, "Do you think I'll let those two little bastards go? Let me tell you, even if you naked and lie in front of me and beg me, it's impossible!" Who the hell cares about a bowl of porridge! When he, Lan Yiyang, had never fought, no one dared to touch his face.As a result, those two bastards broke the bridge of his nose. According to his past temper, he had to remember to repay the other party ten times!
Mu Rulan paused and stood up slowly. The warm smile at the corner of her mouth disappeared. Her clear eyes looked at him with a hint of condemnation and indifference. The sudden sharp contrast made her whole body uncomfortable.
Lan Yiyang stared at her.
Mu Rulan said: "You may have misunderstood. I am not here today to ask you to forgive my two brothers, but because they did something wrong. Sisters are like mothers. I did not teach them well, and it was wrong of me to hurt you. So I will fulfill my responsibilities and obligations. I will pay for the medical expenses and apologize. But please don't forget why you were beaten by my brother. You suddenly heard an inexplicable man on the street saying that he wanted to have sex with your mother. Wouldn't you be angry?"
Lan Yiyang's eyes widened and he looked at her in surprise with his mouth slightly open. He didn't expect that this woman who made him feel warm and a little artificial would make such a comparison, but to his surprise, this person seemed so real...
